whyNeedTitle: Why do I need Manager ID?
whyNeedDescription: To analyze your team, I need access to your players, captain, and rankings.
helpText: 💡 You can find your Manager ID on your FPL page in the URL after /entry/

errors.invalidFormat: Manager ID must be a number (1-10 digits)

validatingWithFpl: Validating Manager ID with FPL servers...

network_error.title: Connection issue
network_error.description: Unable to connect to FPL servers. This could be a network issue or FPL server maintenance.
suggestions: Try again in a few moments
FPL servers may be temporarily down

rate_limit.title: Too many requests
rate_limit.description: FPL servers are limiting requests. This is normal during busy periods.
suggestions: FPL servers are busy at popular times
Try during off-peak hours for a faster response

invalid_id.title: Manager ID not found
invalid_id.description: The Manager ID you entered does not exist in the FPL database.
suggestions: Double-check your Manager ID in your FPL account
Look for the number after "/entry/" in your FPL URL
Make sure you're using your own Manager ID

timeout.title: Request timeout
timeout.description: Validation is taking longer than expected. FPL servers may be slow.
suggestions: Try again with a fresh request
Consider saving anyway and verifying later

server_error.title: FPL server error
server_error.description: Fantasy Premier League servers are having issues.
suggestions: Your Manager ID will be saved and verified later
Check FPL's official social media for updates

unknown.title: Unexpected error
suggestions: Contact support if the problem persists
